name: Mischa
source:
Loyal and Strong

A woman of few words, Mischa can be hard to read. A loyal partner, she can always be counted on to get the job done—but her tenacity is born from tragic roots. 

Can you help her overcome her past and learn to rely upon those around her?

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1470015663943163906?s=20&t=cp2Bb5I1qzUClYj_2_plbw]official Twitter[/url]]
